characters.description: Haven's founder, an accomplished hunter and alchemist, and the Malefic Viper's Chosen. After the Yalsten treasure hunt, Jake turns toward unfinished obligations, family, and the dangerous projects waiting for him at home.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron and the head of the Malefic Order.
characters.name: Villy

characters.description: Haven's practical leader and a verdant witch. She manages the city's defenses and interests while Jake is away, balancing his ambitions against the needs of the people who rely on Haven. She remains one of Jake's principal allies and handles the city's daily direction.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: Jake's young hawk companion, whom he helped raise. They share a private, unusual bond, and she has an affinity for wind.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: The patriarch of the Noboru Clan and Reika's great-grandfather. He remains weakened after his duel with Jake and retains possession of the disputed blood legacy.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: A Noboru Clan alchemist and the Sword Saint's great-granddaughter.
characters.name: Reika

characters.description: A Risen curse expert and dungeon engineer who is among Jake's established contacts.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: Casper's Risen co-operator and a curse-sensitive contact. She works with him on matters involving dangerous curse energy, contributing a distinct sensitivity that supports their shared efforts and helps them recognize threats related to their work.
characters.name: Lyra

characters.description: Haven's merchant and one of Jake's established allies.
characters.name: Sultan

characters.description: Haven's inventor and infrastructure builder.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: A Haven mage considered as a possible recipient of a rare legacy centered on light magic.
characters.name: Lillian

characters.description: Jake's brother, who pursues William after the intruder bypasses the Court of Shadows' defenses and questions Caleb's family. Caleb investigates William's unexplained strength, travel, and interest in Jake.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: A powerful former human who infiltrates the Court of Shadows to gather information about Jake and Caleb. Years in Nevermore have made him far stronger, and the unknown means by which he returned to Earth adds to the threat.
characters.name: William

characters.description: The Holy Church's augur in Sanct Domo, whom William intends to consult while investigating Jake's past.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: A Risen representative who works with Casper on plans for a refuge suited to their kind. She warns Jake that strengthening his hunger curse could change or overwhelm him.
characters.name: Priscilla

characters.description: The level-100 builder overseeing Jake's underground alchemy complex. He brings Jake into the nearly finished facility to help fit its resistant entrance gates.
characters.name: Hank

characters.description: The former final foe of Jake's tutorial, restored from the soul fragment preserved in Jake's mask. Their accidental life bond gives Jake power over his continued existence, so they pursue a voluntary alliance and a safer route to his freedom.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: A disciple of the Malefic Viper who administers the Order's academy. Duskleaf observes Jake's handling of his curse and helps assess how his new title will affect future creations. The approaching enrollment date also places Jake's recovery on a firm schedule.
characters.name: Duskleaf

characters.description: A Haven builder blessed by the Malefic Viper. He oversees a Viper-directed monument designed to connect Earth with the Malefic Order once its charge is complete. Chris treats the project as a direct commission and regards Jake as Haven's lord.
characters.name: Chris

characters.description: A wounded human axe warrior seen in a historical record of the Malefic Viper's S-grade past. Faced with a physically superior dragon, he continues fighting with absolute confidence and turns the Viper's broken fang into a weapon.
characters.name: Valdemar

characters.description: A level-109 elf enslaved after her clan's fall. The Order conditioned her to withstand poisons, used her in toxin trials, and prepared her for service. She is selected as the permanent steward of an important new academy entrant, whom she soon learns is Jake.
characters.name: Mira
